findings.claim: The change adds a new non-domain/non-ports dependency to fdb-app despite the acceptance constraint that fdb-app depends on domain+ports only.
findings.evidence: Diff adds `sha2 = { workspace = true }` to `crates/fdb-app/Cargo.toml`; acceptance criteria Constraints state: `Zero infra deps in fdb-domain (serde only); fdb-app depends on domain+ports only.`
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the new fdb-app dependency or update the design/acceptance criteria before adding hashing infrastructure to fdb-app.

findings.claim: Validation accepts an IndexSpec with an empty columns list, allowing the generator to emit invalid SQL.
findings.evidence: The index validation loop checks index name, duplicates, reserved tenant-index name, and each referenced column, but has no `idx.columns.is_empty()` rejection; `crates/fdb-app/src/provision/ddl.rs` later emits `CREATE {unique_kw}INDEX IF NOT EXISTS {name} ON {ns}.{t} ({});` using `columns.join(", ")`, which becomes `CREATE INDEX ... ();` for an empty list.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a SpecError variant for empty index column lists and reject `idx.columns.is_empty()` before generation.
